pr_metadata.title: fix(box): arch-suffix the prebuilt mq_prometheus check in build-fatbox.sh (follow-up to #1100)
pr_metadata.summary: One coupling point #1100 missed: build-fatbox.sh's obs/mq-ubuntu pre-bake existence check hardcoded mq_prometheus-x64, so arm64 bakes failed 'prebuilt mq_prometheus not found' (cache has mq_prometheus-arm64). Derive the suffix from the baker's own --arch.
pr_metadata.notes: Verified: vrg-validate all green (common/lint incl. shellcheck/typecheck/test 1199 passed @100% cov/audit). Exhaustive grep confirms this was the last x64 hardcoding (mqexporter.py, build-mq-exporter-binary.sh, mq-exporter role already arch-aware from #1100/#1101). One-line-class change (case on ARCH -> arm64|x64) matching binary_name(). Unblocks nativeha-ubuntu --no-dr bring-up on Apple Silicon (mq-nativeha box already builds; obs/mq-ubuntu were the last blocked bakes).
